payload.summary: The council's transparency page, listing every payment it made to a supplier over £500. Monthly files in CSV and PDF go back to 2020, and 2013 to 2018 can be had by email on request. It is the most detailed spending data Norwich puts out, though the one month we read, January 2026, has no cost centre that names licensing.
